source.check: names from the OCR text; returned unopposed, no poll

note: Triennial election of the rural district council (29 divisions), 1936: nominations received by W. R. Bell, J.P., 28 April 1936. Party labels are not printed for the unopposed members. No nominations for Camly, Creggan, Drumbanagher, Lathbirget, Mountnorris, Mullaghbane, Poyntzpass and Tullyhappy, where the sitting members (not named) were automatically re-elected. Returned unopposed. William Cooke: no party label printed in 1936. At other elections he stood as Unionist (Newtownhamilton, Armagh County Council, 25 May 1939, printed 'U': Armagh Guardian, 28 April 1939, p. 3 ("Labour to Oppose Nationalists: Armagh Co. Council Elections")).
